six weeks in. the scale barely moved and every number that matters did

#fitnessapp #progress #soma

slides.text:
Six weeks in

The scale barely moved

But the photos moved

Same light, same corner,
six weeks apart

And so did the nights

The number I never
used to look at

A month you can see

Not a streak I had to keep

Nothing dramatic
happened

That's why it worked

slides.heading: Progress you can actually check
slides.body: SOMA keeps the photos, the nights and the sessions side by side — so you can see the change instead of guessing at it
